body.label: Translated by Dora Zsom.
body.value: The weekly Torah portion “Va-etḥanan” [Deuteronomy 3:23–7:11]; the entire Book of [Commandments by] Ḥefets [ben Yatsliaḥ]; [halakhic] questions; the Introduction [to the Talmud] of Samuel ben Ḥofni [Ga’on]; [Rashi’s] commentary on tractate Sukkah; [halakhic] questions; Gemara: Me‘ilah; commentary on Yevamot; Tractate Niddah; three booklets: a commentary on Niddah, a commentary on Bava Batra, and a commentary on Makkot; Book of Geometry in Hebrew letters; collected midrashim; Fasts; [Se‘adya Ga’on’s] Book of Refutation of the Separatists [i.e., the Karaites]; Gemara: Bava Meẓi’a; glossary of Seder Mo‘ed; subjects connected to the year [i.e., the daily prayers for the whole year]; commentary on Job; midrash of the sages [possibly chapter 6 of Pirke avot]; questions; commentary on Genesis; collection of midrash; [Nissim Ibn Shāhīn’s] The Scroll of Secrets; some of [the Muslim philosopher] al-Kindi’s treatises; questions; homiletic interpretation of the [book of] Lamentations; [Se‘adya Ga’on’s] Book of the Spheres [on astronomy]; the Twelve Prophets; Scripture; commentary on
